title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Discussion…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WP Discussion Board versions up to 2.6.0. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers with limited privileges to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity impact with potential confidentiality, integrity, and availability consequences.
